question: If x² = y + z, y² = z + x, z² = x + y, then the value of {1over x+1}+{1over y+1}+{1over z+1} will be:
solution:
**Given:**

x² = y + z

y² = z + x

z² = x + y

**Calculation:**

x² + x = y + z + x

x (x + 1) = x + y + z

1/(x + 1) = x/(x + y + z)

Similarly,

1/(y + 1) = y/(x + y + z)

1/(z + 1) = z/(x + y + z)

Add all three above equation,

{1over x+1}+{1over y+1}+{1over z+1} = x/(x + y + z) + y/(x + y + z) + z/(x + y + z)

⇒ {1over x+1}+{1over y+1}+{1over z+1} = (x + y + z)/(x + y + z) = 1

**∴ The value of 1/(x+1) + 1/(y+1) + 1/(z+1) is 1.**
